articles.title_en: Commonality in systemic risk from green and conventional energy
articles.title_cn: 绿色能源与常规能源的系统性风险共性
articles.abstract_en: Our study is a novel attempt to examine the sub-industry sectors of conventional energy (i.e., oil & gas, crude production, oil refinery & marketing, and oil equipment and services) and the sub-industry sector of green energy (i.e., renewable energy) to analyse the systemic risk and commonality. The results show that the systemic risk for green energy has decreased since 2006, indicating a shift towards net-zero emissions. Further, we develop a systemic contagion index (SCI) for green and conventional energy. The SCI shows that green energy has lower contagion than conventional energy. However, conventional energy appears to create lower contagion during crises, indicating its herding characteristics and investors' preference for conventional energy during crises. A mild systemic risk commonality between green and conventional energy provides an opportunity to shift towards green energy, thus enhancing the possibility of achieving net-zero emissions. These findings provide guidance to policymakers to build the global green and conventional energy policy to achieve net-zero emissions in 2050.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们的研究是一项新颖的尝试，考察常规能源的子行业部门（即石油与天然气、原油生产、炼油与销售、石油设备与服务）以及绿色能源的子行业部门（即可再生能源），以分析系统性风险及其共性。结果表明，自2006年以来，绿色能源的系统性风险有所下降，表明向净零排放的转变。此外，我们为绿色能源和常规能源开发了一个系统性传染指数（SCI）。SCI显示，绿色能源的传染性低于常规能源。然而，常规能源在危机期间似乎产生较低的传染性，表明其羊群行为特征以及投资者在危机期间对常规能源的偏好。绿色能源与常规能源之间温和的系统性风险共性为向绿色能源转变提供了机会，从而增强了实现净零排放的可能性。这些发现为政策制定者构建全球绿色和常规能源政策以实现2050年净零排放提供了指导。

articles.title_en: Climate change, environmental policies in the housing sector of Italy, and the impact on social welfare
articles.title_cn: 气候变化、意大利住房部门的环境政策及其对社会福利的影响
articles.abstract_en: The European Commission has significantly increased its focus on sustainability issues and the growing energy deficit. Residential consumption has been identified as one of the most energy-intensive segments, prompting the Commission to propose an Energy Performance of Buildings Directive. This directive aims to establish minimum standards for buildings to be met within specified timeframes. In this context, it is crucial to identify and address all potential drawbacks of such measures, ensuring that not only environmental but also social and economic aspects of sustainability are considered. This paper examines the impact of a fiscal incentive, called the Superbonus, implemented by the Italian government to promote sustainable investments and facilitate the recovery of the real estate sector following the pandemic. The work contributes to the growing literature on climate policies by focusing on the indirect effects on households and welfare through the analysis of the allocation of government resources across geographical areas and its impact on the housing market. The study employs a difference-in-differences approach with a continuous treatment variable to analyze the impact of the Superbonus on the real estate market, using data from Milan's residential market over the period 2016–2021. The results indicate that, while the fiscal incentive may have produced undesired welfare effects, the impact on the housing market led to a more equitable redistribution, albeit limited to those who already owned properties. The paper disentangles the main underlying mechanisms behind these effects, contributing both from an academic perspective and offering several political insights.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧盟委员会显著加强了对可持续性问题及日益增长的能源赤字的关注。住宅消费已被确定为能源密集型最高的领域之一，促使委员会提出《建筑能效指令》。该指令旨在设定在特定时间框架内需达到的建筑最低标准。在此背景下，识别并解决此类措施的所有潜在弊端至关重要，确保不仅考虑环境方面，也考虑可持续性的社会和经济层面。本文考察了意大利政府为促进可持续投资并推动疫情后房地产行业复苏而实施的财政激励措施（称为“超级奖金”）的影响。本研究通过分析政府资源在地理区域间的分配及其对住房市场的影响，聚焦于对家庭和福利的间接效应，为日益增长的气候政策文献做出贡献。研究采用连续处理变量的双重差分方法，利用米兰住宅市场2016-2021年期间的数据，分析“超级奖金”对房地产市场的影响。结果表明，尽管财政激励可能产生了非预期的福利效应，但对住房市场的影响导致了更公平的再分配，尽管仅限于那些已经拥有房产的人。本文厘清了这些效应背后的主要机制，既从学术角度做出贡献，也提供了若干政策见解。

articles.title_en: The effect of pricing instruments on CO2 emissions: Empirical evidence from Australia
articles.title_cn: 定价工具对二氧化碳排放的影响：来自澳大利亚的经验证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the emission reduction effects of a mix of market-based climate policies in Australia, where a dramatic ramp-up of incentives for renewable electricity generation since 2009 was paired with a carbon tax that was introduced in 2012 and repealed in 2014. A synthetic control method is employed to estimate the joint effect of these policies, finding that the renewable energy incentives and carbon tax policies together reduced Australia’s annual per capita CO2 emissions by 7.15% on average between 2009 and 2018. The emission reduction impacts were attenuated but not reversed when the carbon price was repealed in 2014 and the renewable targets were softened in 2015. We also find that the policy mix did not reduce the production of Australian coal and may in fact have expanded its export. The findings suggest that even short-lived climate change mitigation policies can have substantial and persistent effects on emissions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了澳大利亚混合市场型气候政策的减排效果，该国自2009年起大幅增加对可再生能源发电的激励措施，并于2012年引入碳税，2014年废除。采用合成控制法估计这些政策的联合效应，发现可再生能源激励和碳税政策共同使澳大利亚2009年至2018年间人均年二氧化碳排放平均减少7.15%。当碳价格于2014年被废除以及可再生能源目标于2015年被软化时，减排影响有所减弱但未逆转。我们还发现，政策组合并未减少澳大利亚煤炭的生产，反而可能扩大了其出口。研究结果表明，即使是短期的减缓气候变化政策也能对排放产生显著且持久的影响。

articles.title_en: Climate change economics in Vietnam: Redefining economic impact
articles.title_cn: 越南气候变化经济学：重新定义经济影响
articles.abstract_en: Vietnam, a low middle-income economy, grapples with considerable climate impacts, primarily driven by heat waves, sea level rise, and tropical cyclones. Under ongoing global warming, these extreme weather events are projected to further intensify. We use a dynamic general equilibrium model to study economic transition dynamics from 2015 to 2100, accounting for heat-induced labor productivity losses, agricultural land loss from sea level rise, and residential property damage from tropical cyclones. We compare a Paris-compatible strong mitigation scenario where global warming is limited to well below 2 °C above preindustrial levels to a strong emission scenario where warming reaches 4–5 °C. We find that the impacts of climate change on output and investment are highly uncertain, with differences between the two emission scenarios remaining statistically insignificant until the end of the century, despite substantially higher climate forcing in the latter. By contrast, consumption losses are significantly larger under the high emission scenario. These negative impacts are primarily driven by heat-induced labor productivity losses, while TCs are the main source of uncertainty. Our findings highlight the need for analytical frameworks to capture the different channels through which climate and climate change affect economic development, rather than focusing mainly on output-related damage, as done in many existing studies.
articles.abstract_cn: 越南，一个中低收入经济体，正面临显著的气候影响，主要由热浪、海平面上升和热带气旋驱动。在全球持续变暖的背景下，这些极端天气事件预计将进一步加剧。我们使用动态一般均衡模型研究从2015年到2100年的经济转型动态，考虑了热引起的劳动生产率损失、海平面上升导致的农业土地损失以及热带气旋造成的住宅财产损失。我们比较了巴黎协定兼容的强减排情景（全球变暖限制在比工业化前水平高2°C以下）与强排放情景（变暖达到4-5°C）。我们发现气候变化对产出和投资的影响高度不确定，两种排放情景之间的差异在本世纪末之前统计上不显著，尽管后者的气候强迫显著更高。相比之下，高排放情景下的消费损失显著更大。这些负面影响主要由热引起的劳动生产率损失驱动，而热带气旋是主要的不确定性来源。我们的发现强调了分析框架需要捕捉气候和气候变化影响经济发展的不同渠道，而不是像许多现有研究那样主要关注产出相关的损害。

articles.title_en: Energy markets reforms and renewable energy in Africa: Do public–private partnership matter?
articles.title_cn: 能源市场改革与非洲可再生能源：公私合作伙伴关系是否重要？
articles.abstract_en: Access to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy is crucial for economic growth, industrialization, and social development. However, a significant portion of the Sub-Saharan population still lacks electricity, hindering both economic and social progress. This article examines the impact of electricity market reforms on the production and consumption of renewable energy, with a particular emphasis on the role of public–private partnerships (PPPs). The analysis is based on a panel of 18 African countries from 1990 to 2014 and utilizes local projections in conjunction with an augmented inverse probability weighted regression adjustment (LP-AIPW) estimator to mitigate selection bias. The findings reveal that reforms generally enhance renewable energy production in the short and medium term, while their effect on consumption is more modest and primarily evident in the medium term. Periods characterized by PPP projects within the energy sector during the analyzed period experience greater and more sustained benefits, underscoring the importance of integrating market reforms with complementary policies. Overall, these results highlight the potential of market reforms and PPPs to expedite Africa’s energy transition and achieve universal access to clean, reliable, and affordable energy, in alignment with Sustainable Development Goal 7.
articles.abstract_cn: 获取可靠、负担得起且可持续的能源对经济增长、工业化和社会发展至关重要。然而，撒哈拉以南非洲仍有大量人口缺乏电力，这阻碍了经济和社会进步。本文考察了电力市场改革对可再生能源生产和消费的影响，特别强调了公私合作伙伴关系（PPPs）的作用。分析基于1990年至2014年间18个非洲国家的面板数据，并利用局部投影结合增强的逆概率加权回归调整（LP-AIPW）估计器来减轻选择偏差。研究结果显示，改革通常在短期和中期内提升可再生能源生产，而对消费的影响则较为温和，且主要在中期内显现。在分析期间，能源部门存在PPP项目的时期经历了更大且更持久的收益，这强调了将市场改革与配套政策相结合的重要性。总体而言，这些结果凸显了市场改革和PPP在加速非洲能源转型及实现普遍获取清洁、可靠和负担得起的能源方面的潜力，这与可持续发展目标7相一致。

articles.title_en: Beliefs, evidence, and climate action
articles.title_cn: 信念、证据与气候行动
articles.abstract_en: We assess how changes in the scientific consensus around equilibrium climate sensitivity (ECS), as captured by the IPCC’s Fifth (AR5) and Sixth (AR6) Assessment Reports, impact policymakers’ willingness to take climate action. Taking the IPCC’s reports at face value, the ECS estimates in AR6 would have lowered a policymaker’s willingness to act on climate relative to AR5 due to a narrower “likely” range. However, Bayesian updating may reverse this conclusion. An accuracy-motivated policymaker who was not convinced to take greater climate action by the evidence in AR5 may be more likely to increase their investment in clean energy by the evidence in AR6.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了围绕平衡气候敏感性（ECS）的科学共识变化，如IPCC第五次（AR5）和第六次（AR6）评估报告所捕捉的，如何影响政策制定者采取气候行动的意愿。从表面价值来看IPCC的报告，AR6中的ECS估计由于更窄的“可能”范围，会降低政策制定者相对于AR5采取气候行动的意愿。然而，贝叶斯更新可能会逆转这一结论。一个以准确性为动机的政策制定者，如果未被AR5中的证据说服采取更大的气候行动，可能更有可能因AR6中的证据而增加对清洁能源的投资。

articles.title_en: Can grid tariffs be fair and efficient? A comprehensive evaluation of tariff designs for smart electric vehicle integration
articles.title_cn: 电网电价能否既公平又高效？智能电动汽车整合电价设计的综合评估
articles.abstract_en: The rapid adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) is increasing electricity demand and raising capacity requirements on distribution grids that in many countries are already near their limits. Grid tariffs that reflect capacity costs can promote more efficient use of the grid infrastructure and encourage smart charging of EVs, including optimization of the timing and speed of charging to reduce peak loads. However, most existing tariffs provide limited incentives for such behaviour. In recent years, various alternative tariff designs have been proposed, yet comprehensive evidence on their impacts remains limited. This study introduces a framework to evaluate tariff structures against regulatory principles, including efficiency, fairness, and simplicity. Using a case study of public EV charging stations in the Netherlands, the analysis examines how tariff designs, ranging from flat to time-varying and capacity-based, affect smart charging by charging point operators (CPOs), grid expansion costs, and the distribution of costs between households and CPOs. The study further explores how retail electricity pricing schemes (dynamic vs. fixed) and varying EV adoption rates shape these outcomes. The results suggest that existing tariffs lead to high expansion costs and place a disproportionate burden on households without EVs. Alternative tariff designs can reduce grid and total system costs relative to current tariffs and improve fairness by aligning grid charges more closely with users’ contributions to grid peaks. However, no single design performs best across all regulatory principles, implying inherent trade-offs in design of tariffs.
articles.abstract_cn: 电动汽车（EV）的快速普及正在增加电力需求，并提高配电网络的容量要求，在许多国家，这些网络已接近其极限。反映容量成本的电网电价可以促进电网基础设施的更有效利用，并鼓励电动汽车的智能充电，包括优化充电时间和速度以减少峰值负荷。然而，大多数现有电价对此类行为的激励有限。近年来，提出了各种替代电价设计，但对其影响的全面证据仍然有限。本研究引入了一个框架，根据监管原则（包括效率、公平性和简单性）评估电价结构。通过对荷兰公共电动汽车充电站的案例研究，分析考察了从固定电价到时变电价和基于容量的电价等不同电价设计如何影响充电点运营商（CPO）的智能充电、电网扩建成本以及家庭与CPO之间的成本分配。研究进一步探讨了零售电价方案（动态与固定）和不同的电动汽车普及率如何影响这些结果。结果表明，现有电价导致高扩建成本，并对没有电动汽车的家庭造成不成比例的负担。替代电价设计可以相对于当前电价降低电网和总系统成本，并通过使电网收费更紧密地与用户对电网峰值的贡献对齐来提高公平性。然而，没有一种单一设计在所有监管原则下表现最佳，这意味着电价设计中存在固有的权衡。

articles.title_en: Managing the tragedy of commons and polluting emissions: Bertrand vs Cournot
articles.title_cn: 管理公地悲剧与污染排放：伯特兰竞争与古诺竞争的比较
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a comparative assessment, under price or quantity competition, of the effectiveness of emission taxation in triggering firms’ investments in abatement technologies while extracting a renewable resource used as a productive asset to deliver the final good to consumers. Environmental policy is coupled with regulated access to the common pool driving the industry to harvest in correspondence of the maximum sustainable yield. The analysis relies on a state-redundant differential game whose open-loop equilibrium is a degenerate feedback one. Irrespective of the nature of competition, regulating access grants the public authority the possibility of using the tax to minimise emissions, whereby at equilibrium aggregate output, emissions, the residual resource stock and consumer surplus are the same across market regimes, although the number of firms differs. Out of equilibrium, there emerges that price competition facilitates the regulator’s task as price-setting firms are more sensitive to the emission tax and react investing more on aggregate. Finally, the strong version of the Porter hypothesis is validated at the steady state Bertrand equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在价格或数量竞争下，对排放税收在触发企业投资于减排技术同时提取作为生产性资产的可再生资源以向消费者提供最终产品的有效性进行了比较评估。环境政策与对公共资源的受管制准入相结合，促使行业在最大可持续产量对应的水平进行收获。分析依赖于一个状态冗余的微分博弈，其开环均衡是退化的反馈均衡。无论竞争性质如何，管制准入赋予公共当局利用税收最小化排放的可能性，因此在均衡状态下，总产出、排放、剩余资源存量和消费者剩余在不同市场制度下相同，尽管企业数量不同。在非均衡状态下，价格竞争有助于监管者的任务，因为定价企业对排放税更敏感，并在总体上投资更多。最后，波特假说的强版本在稳态伯特兰均衡下得到验证。

articles.title_en: Weather, climate, and economic growth: A dynamic panel analysis using global subnational data
articles.title_cn: 天气、气候与经济增长：基于全球次国家数据的动态面板分析
articles.abstract_en: Using a global subnational dataset covering over 2800 regions, this study analyzes the effects of weather and climate on economic output. We first show that it is crucial to account for serial correlation in output growth. While a static annual panel model suggests a significant aggregate growth effect of temperature (weather effects), this effect disappears and remains significant only in poor regions once we include the lags of output growth, implying that static models could overstate climate damages. Second, to capture the dynamics of climate adaptation, we further extend the long-difference model to allow output responses to evolve over time (climate effects). We find that higher temperatures have a persistent but not permanent negative effect in poor, hot regions, suggesting the development of adaptive capacity. In contrast, temperature effects are largely absent in rich regions. As a result, the income gap between rich and poor regions is projected to widen, exacerbating climate inequality. In addition, we find no robust effects of precipitation in either the annual panel or the long-difference models.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用覆盖超过2800个地区的全球次国家数据集，本研究分析了天气和气候对经济产出的影响。我们首先表明，考虑产出增长中的序列相关性至关重要。虽然静态年度面板模型显示温度对总体增长有显著影响（天气效应），但一旦我们纳入产出增长的滞后项，这种效应消失，并且仅在贫困地区仍然显著，这意味着静态模型可能高估了气候损害。其次，为了捕捉气候适应的动态性，我们进一步扩展了长期差分模型，允许产出响应随时间演变（气候效应）。我们发现，在贫困、炎热地区，较高温度具有持久但非永久性的负面影响，这表明适应能力的发展。相比之下，温度效应在富裕地区基本不存在。因此，预计富裕与贫困地区之间的收入差距将扩大，加剧气候不平等。此外，在年度面板模型或长期差分模型中，我们均未发现降水的稳健效应。

articles.title_en: Eco-innovation strategies in response to energy-related uncertainty and geopolitical risk: Insights from the energy sector
articles.title_cn: 应对能源相关不确定性与地缘政治风险的生态创新策略：来自能源部门的见解
articles.abstract_en: This study examines eco-innovation investment strategies across the global energy sector in response to energy security concerns and geopolitical risks. Drawing on growth options theory and real options theory, and using a comprehensive dataset of 1351 energy firms across 20 countries from 2002 to 2020 (10,501 firm-year observations), we find that energy-related uncertainty and geopolitical risk play significant roles in shaping firms' eco-innovation strategies. Energy-related uncertainty is positively associated with eco-innovation, suggesting that firms increase investments in eco-innovation to manage uncertainty and enhance energy security. However, this positive effect weakens as geopolitical risk intensifies. In other words, while energy-related uncertainty can stimulate eco-innovation, political instability dampens this relationship. Overall, our findings advance both theory and practice by providing new insights into how energy firms adjust their eco-innovation strategies amid geopolitical conflict and energy-related uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了全球能源部门在应对能源安全关切和地缘政治风险时的生态创新投资策略。基于增长期权理论和实物期权理论，并利用2002年至2020年间覆盖20个国家1351家能源企业的综合数据集（10,501个企业-年度观测值），我们发现能源相关不确定性和地缘政治风险在塑造企业生态创新策略中发挥着重要作用。能源相关不确定性与生态创新呈正相关，表明企业增加生态创新投资以管理不确定性并增强能源安全。然而，这种正向效应随着地缘政治风险的加剧而减弱。换言之，虽然能源相关不确定性可以刺激生态创新，但政治不稳定会削弱这种关系。总体而言，我们的发现通过提供关于能源企业在地缘政治冲突和能源相关不确定性中如何调整其生态创新策略的新见解，推进了理论与实践。

articles.title_en: Breaking the natural gas subsidy trap: Implications for Bolivia’s power system transition to 2040
articles.title_cn: 打破天然气补贴陷阱：对玻利维亚电力系统向2040年转型的影响
articles.abstract_en: Latin America faces a triple challenge: achieving economic growth to narrow the income gap with advanced economies, reducing inequality, and protecting the environment. Energy lies at the nexus of these objectives. Bolivia, a natural gas producer in the region, subsidizes gas prices for domestic consumption and power generation — policies that entail significant opportunity costs in the long term while seeking to mitigate short-term economic disruptions. This paper develops energy transition pathways to explore renewable energy adoption in Bolivia and its prospects for achieving net-zero emissions by 2050. A capacity expansion model (PyPSA-Earth) is greatly enhanced to accurately represent the Bolivian power system with high spatial and temporal resolution. The refined model evaluates a business-as-usual (BAU) scenario alongside five alternative pathways to 2040. The analysis focuses on the role of existing natural gas subsidies, exploring various reduction strategies and their implications for the optimal power system configuration in 2040. Scenario results indicate that Bolivia’s current BAU trajectory could be up to €2.5 billion more expensive than alternative transition pathways. With subsidies amounting to €5–7 billion, sufficient fiscal space exists to finance renewable deployment under these alternatives. The findings highlight multiple feasible pathways for achieving sustainability, a measured subsidy reform in line with social equity, and cost efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 拉丁美洲面临三重挑战：实现经济增长以缩小与发达经济体的收入差距、减少不平等以及保护环境。能源处于这些目标的交汇点。玻利维亚是该地区的天然气生产国，对国内消费和发电的天然气价格进行补贴——这些政策在寻求缓解短期经济 disruption 的同时，长期来看会带来显著的机会成本。本文开发了能源转型路径，以探索玻利维亚可再生能源的采用及其到2050年实现净零排放的前景。一个容量扩展模型（PyPSA-Earth）被大幅增强，以高空间和时间分辨率准确表示玻利维亚电力系统。改进后的模型评估了基准情景（BAU）以及到2040年的五种替代路径。分析聚焦于现有天然气补贴的作用，探讨各种削减策略及其对2040年最优电力系统配置的影响。情景结果表明，玻利维亚当前的BAU轨迹可能比替代转型路径昂贵高达2.5亿欧元。由于补贴总额达5-7亿欧元，存在足够的财政空间来为这些替代方案下的可再生能源部署提供资金。研究结果强调了实现可持续性的多条可行路径、与社会公平相一致的适度补贴改革以及成本效率。

articles.title_en: Carbon neutrality through industry 4.0: A decision-making approach for sustainable energy efficient logistics operations
articles.title_cn: 通过工业4.0实现碳中和：可持续节能物流运营的决策方法
articles.abstract_en: Logistics and related activities are key contributors to carbon emissions (CEs) but are essential for the success of supply chain (SC) operations in the logistics industry. Given the high energy consumption and substantial carbon footprint of the logistics industry, energy efficiency(EE) is a primary concern for business firms. The need to reduce emissions and energy consumption makes sourcing, manufacturing, delivering, and returning products more complex processes; hence, the requirement for sustainable, energy-efficient logistics (SEEL) is critical in this regard. Industry 4.0 (I4.0) technologies can improve the economic and environmental performance of SEEL. However, the process of contextual decision-making to identify key attributes for achieving carbon neutrality in SEEL operations has not been extensively explored. This study identifies and analyzes 20 key attributes critical for enhancing SEEL operations. This study uses a five-phased integrated method encompassing the best worst method (BWM), measurement of alternatives and ranking according to the compromise solution (MARCOS), and Bayesian network (BN) approaches to analyse the attributes. The interrelationships between carbon neutrality categories and I4.0 technologies in SEEL operations were also investigated to enable impactful decision-making. The analysis suggests that artificial intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT) have slightly higher probabilities of making a significant impact than big data analytics (BDA) and cloud computing (CC), emphasising their role in optimising energy usage, predictive maintenance, and intelligent resource allocation. The distinct ranking of sustainability options, including the adoption of renewable energy, circular economy strategies, and energy-efficient building design, offers a guiding framework for policymakers.
articles.abstract_cn: 物流及相关活动是碳排放（CEs）的主要贡献者，但对于物流行业供应链（SC）运营的成功至关重要。鉴于物流行业的高能耗和大量碳足迹，能源效率（EE）是企业关注的首要问题。减少排放和能源消耗的需求使得采购、制造、交付和退货流程更加复杂；因此，可持续节能物流（SEEL）的需求在此方面至关重要。工业4.0（I4.0）技术可以改善SEEL的经济和环境绩效。然而，在SEEL运营中识别实现碳中和关键属性的情境决策过程尚未得到广泛探索。本研究识别并分析了增强SEEL运营的20个关键属性。本研究采用五阶段集成方法，包括最优最劣法（BWM）、基于折中解的备选方案测量与排序（MARCOS）和贝叶斯网络（BN）方法来分析这些属性。还调查了SEEL运营中碳中和类别与I4.0技术之间的相互关系，以支持有影响力的决策。分析表明，人工智能（AI）和物联网（IoT）产生显著影响的可能性略高于大数据分析（BDA）和云计算（CC），强调了它们在优化能源使用、预测性维护和智能资源分配中的作用。可持续性选项的独特排序，包括采用可再生能源、循环经济策略和节能建筑设计，为政策制定者提供了指导框架。

articles.title_en: Low-carbon transformation of iron and steel: Combined effects of green hydrogen subsidy and carbon emissions trading under uncertain environments
articles.title_cn: 钢铁行业低碳转型：不确定环境下绿氢补贴与碳排放交易的联合效应
articles.abstract_en: The low-carbon transformation of iron and steel industry (ISI) is crucial to China ‘s goal of carbon neutrality, but this process is affected by long-term changes in production structure and short-term market fluctuations. This study constructs an inter-temporal stochastic evolutionary game framework of a coupled optimization model, aiming to analyze how policy mix can effectively stimulate the low-carbon transformation of ISI in uncertain environments, and identify the key factors affecting the strategic interaction between iron and steel enterprises (ISEs) and local governments. We also analyze the impact of uncertainty on the economic and environmental benefits of the low-carbon production path of ISEs. The research shows that the strategy interaction presents three-stage characteristics of policy-driven, bottleneck-watching and market-driven, and the evolution trend is closely related to factors including the initial strategy selection probability, taxation, and low-carbon value recognition of steel products. Under the single carbon emission trading (CET) policy, the probability of ISEs choosing a low-carbon production path has declined significantly during the bottleneck wait-and-see period, while the policy combination of green hydrogen subsidy and CET alleviates this downward trend and makes it converge to a steady state faster. Green hydrogen price and CET price are the sources of uncertainty affecting carbon emissions and benefits, with the uncertainty in green hydrogen prices having a more pronounced impact. This study provides an analytical tool and decision-making reference for understanding the dynamic mechanism of low-carbon transformation in ISI under uncertain environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 钢铁行业的低碳转型对中国碳中和目标至关重要，但这一过程受到生产结构长期变化和短期市场波动的影响。本研究构建了一个耦合优化模型的跨期随机演化博弈框架，旨在分析政策组合如何在不确定环境中有效激励钢铁行业的低碳转型，并识别影响钢铁企业与地方政府之间战略互动的关键因素。我们还分析了不确定性对钢铁企业低碳生产路径的经济和环境效益的影响。研究表明，战略互动呈现出政策驱动、瓶颈观望和市场驱动的三阶段特征，演化趋势与初始策略选择概率、税收和钢铁产品低碳价值认知等因素密切相关。在单一碳排放交易政策下，钢铁企业在瓶颈观望期选择低碳生产路径的概率显著下降，而绿氢补贴与碳排放交易的政策组合缓解了这一下降趋势，并使其更快收敛到稳定状态。绿氢价格和碳排放交易价格是影响碳排放和效益的不确定性来源，其中绿氢价格的不确定性影响更为显著。本研究为理解不确定环境下钢铁行业低碳转型的动态机制提供了分析工具和决策参考。

articles.title_en: Fuel diversification among firms and common ownership
articles.title_cn: 企业间的燃料多样化与共同所有权
articles.abstract_en: We develop a duopoly model that incorporates fuel diversification, resulting in ex post cost asymmetry between firms. We theoretically examine how common ownership influences welfare. Our findings indicate that welfare decreases (increases) with the degree of common ownership when ex post cost heterogeneity due to fuel diversification is small (large). Moreover, we identify a potential U-shaped relationship between the degree of common ownership and welfare, an insight not previously documented in the literature. In addition, we demonstrate that common ownership promotes fuel diversification, which may further enhance welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含燃料多样化的双寡头模型，导致企业间事后成本不对称。我们从理论上考察了共同所有权如何影响福利。我们的研究结果表明，当因燃料多样化导致的事后成本异质性较小（较大）时，福利随共同所有权程度的提高而降低（增加）。此外，我们识别出共同所有权程度与福利之间可能存在U型关系，这一见解在以往文献中未被记录。另外，我们证明共同所有权促进了燃料多样化，这可能进一步增强福利。

articles.title_en: Can renewable energy development alleviate household energy poverty? Evidence from household survey data in China
articles.title_cn: 可再生能源发展能否缓解家庭能源贫困？来自中国家庭调查数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: While renewable energy is central to global climate goals, its distributional impact on household energy poverty in developing economies remains underexplored. Combining household-level data from the China Family Panel Studies with a city-level renewable energy index, this study quantifies the effect of renewable energy development on energy poverty in China. The study finds that: (1) City-level renewable energy development significantly reduces the likelihood of energy poverty among Chinese households, and this result remains robust to tests addressing endogeneity, measurement validity, model specification, and confounding policy factors. (2) The poverty-reducing effect is most pronounced in regions with abundant solar resources and favorable hydropower potential, as well as in western regions and economically underdeveloped areas. (3) Mechanism analysis suggests that renewable energy development may alleviate energy poverty by increasing household income, improving air quality in initially more polluted cities, and enhancing energy infrastructure. (4) Further evidence indicates that renewable energy is associated with lower energy poverty from both “generation” and “consumption” perspectives, with hydropower showing the most robust contribution. These findings provide empirical evidence for assessing the social consequences of renewable energy transitions and inform the design of equitable energy policies in developing economies.
articles.abstract_cn: 虽然可再生能源是全球气候目标的核心，但其对发展中经济体家庭能源贫困的分配影响仍未得到充分探讨。本研究将中国家庭追踪调查的家庭层面数据与城市层面的可再生能源指数相结合，量化了可再生能源发展对中国能源贫困的影响。研究发现：（1）城市层面的可再生能源发展显著降低了中国家庭陷入能源贫困的可能性，并且这一结果在应对内生性、测量有效性、模型设定和混杂政策因素的检验中依然稳健。（2）减贫效应在太阳能资源丰富和水电潜力有利的地区，以及西部地区和经济欠发达地区最为显著。（3）机制分析表明，可再生能源发展可能通过增加家庭收入、改善初始污染较重城市的空气质量以及增强能源基础设施来缓解能源贫困。（4）进一步证据表明，可再生能源与从“发电”和“消费”两个角度衡量的较低能源贫困相关，其中水电的贡献最为稳健。这些发现为评估可再生能源转型的社会后果提供了实证证据，并为发展中经济体设计公平的能源政策提供了信息。

articles.title_en: The role of managerial risk preferences on effectiveness of wind subsidies
articles.title_cn: 管理层风险偏好对风电补贴有效性的作用
articles.abstract_en: Do risk preferences from wind project managers differentially determine the effectiveness of output-based and capital-based tax credits to wind investments? I address this question by developing and estimating a rational expectations equilibrium framework, disciplined to ERCOT plant-level microdata, that exploits this fundamental design difference between the Production Tax Credit (PTC) and the Investment Tax Credit (ITC). I show that the inherently riskier profile of output-based PTC benefits — tied to the stochastic future performance of wind output — induces project managers to invest more in wind capacity than under an alternative present-value-equivalent capital-based ITC subsidy (certain at the time of investment decisions). This occurs because output-based subsidies introduce greater uncertainty into the stream of investment cash flows — tied to the compensation payments of wind project managers — compared to their capital-based counterparts. As a result, managers over-invest (relative to the capital-based subsidy) as a form of self-insurance against this increased variance to limit potential compensation shortfalls that emerge from downside output risk over the decades-long investment horizons of wind projects. This mechanism renders output-based subsidies more effective at stimulating wind investments than present-value-equivalent capital-based tax credits.
articles.abstract_cn: 风电项目经理的风险偏好是否会差异性地决定基于产出和基于资本的税收抵免对风电投资的有效性？我通过开发和估计一个理性预期均衡框架来解决这个问题，该框架以ERCOT电厂级微观数据为校准依据，利用了生产税收抵免（PTC）和投资税收抵免（ITC）之间的这一根本设计差异。我表明，基于产出的PTC收益固有的风险特征——与风电产出的随机未来表现挂钩——促使项目经理在风电容量上的投资多于在等现值基于资本的ITC补贴（在投资决策时确定）下的投资。这是因为，与基于资本的补贴相比，基于产出的补贴给投资现金流序列——与风电项目经理的补偿支付挂钩——带来了更大的不确定性。因此，经理们过度投资（相对于基于资本的补贴）作为对这种增加方差的一种自我保险，以限制在风电项目长达数十年的投资期限内因下行产出风险而可能出现的补偿缺口。这一机制使得基于产出的补贴在刺激风电投资方面比等现值的基于资本的税收抵免更有效。

articles.title_en: Climate action in an endogenous growth model with social capital and wealth taxation
articles.title_cn: 具有社会资本和财富税的内生增长模型中的气候行动
articles.abstract_en: Climate action involves strategies to reduce emissions, strengthen resilience, and promote sustainable practices. Yet its effectiveness depends not only on fiscal instruments but also on social and institutional factors. This paper develops a multi-sector endogenous growth model to examine how social capital and wealth taxation jointly shape the path toward sustainability. The results indicate that social capital amplifies the effectiveness of public spending and reduces the fiscal cost of environmental sustainability. By contrast, when social capital growth is weak, even high levels of wealth taxation may fail to secure environmental sustainability. The paper shows that wealth tax-financed climate action can be growth-compatible, only in the presence of sufficiently strong social capital growth. Strengthening social capital therefore emerge as a central condition for reconciling environmental and economic objectives in the long run. Additionally, the model introduces a novel valuation framework by embedding a permanent wealth tax into the no-arbitrage condition, indicating a Pigouvian-like effect on the economy. However, the quantitative impact of this channel depends on the effectiveness of public spending, which is in turn shaped by the social capital dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候行动涉及减少排放、增强韧性和促进可持续实践的策略。然而，其有效性不仅取决于财政工具，还取决于社会制度和制度因素。本文构建了一个多部门内生增长模型，以考察社会资本和财富税如何共同塑造通往可持续性的路径。结果表明，社会资本增强了公共支出的有效性，并降低了环境可持续性的财政成本。相反，当社会资本增长薄弱时，即使高水平的财富税也可能无法确保环境可持续性。本文表明，只有在社会资本增长足够强劲的情况下，财富税资助的气候行动才能与增长兼容。因此，加强社会资本成为长期内调和环境与经济目标的中心条件。此外，该模型通过将永久财富税嵌入无套利条件，引入了一种新颖的估值框架，表明对经济具有类似庇古税的效果。然而，这一渠道的定量影响取决于公共支出的有效性，而公共支出的有效性又受社会资本动态的影响。

articles.title_en: Exploring the nonlinear causal Nexus between industrial robot imports and renewable energy transition: A PSTR model analysis of belt and road countries
articles.title_cn: 工业机器人进口与可再生能源转型之间的非线性因果联系：一带一路国家的PSTR模型分析
articles.abstract_en: Industrial robots play a significant role in promoting the development of renewable energy throughout the production process. However, this mechanism has not yet been systematically explored in existing research. To address this gap, this study focuses on countries along the Belt and Road Initiative, which accounts for over one-third of global industrial robot imports, and constructs a three-dimensional analytical framework. Specifically, energy intensity is used as the threshold variable for endowment capacity, fossil fuel subsidies and financial development for guiding capacity, and R&D intensity for absorptive capacity. Using a panel smooth transition regression (PSTR) model, we empirically examine the nonlinear impact of industrial robot imports on renewable energy transition and its boundary conditions. The quantitative findings reveal four key patterns. First, robot imports have no effect when the energy intensity is below 5.86, hinder the transition when it falls between 5.86 and 6.83, but promote the transition when it exceeds 6.83. Second, for fossil fuel subsidies, the negative effect is less pronounced at medium levels (1.34–15.46 billion USD), but rebounds at high levels. Third, in the case of financial development, the impact is inverted U-shaped: robot imports facilitate the transition when the credit-to-GDP indicator is below 73.82%, but suppress the transition above this threshold. Fourth, when R&D intensity exceeds 1.67%, robot imports are detrimental to the transition due to technological lock-in. These findings provide policy insights for transitions in developing countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 工业机器人在生产过程中对促进可再生能源发展发挥着重要作用。然而，现有研究尚未系统探讨这一机制。为弥补这一空白，本研究聚焦于占全球工业机器人进口量超过三分之一的一带一路倡议国家，构建了一个三维分析框架。具体而言，以能源强度作为禀赋能力的阈值变量，化石燃料补贴和金融发展作为引导能力的阈值变量，研发强度作为吸收能力的阈值变量。利用面板平滑转换回归（PSTR）模型，我们实证检验了工业机器人进口对可再生能源转型的非线性影响及其边界条件。定量研究结果揭示了四个关键模式。第一，当能源强度低于5.86时，机器人进口没有影响；当能源强度介于5.86和6.83之间时，阻碍转型；但当能源强度超过6.83时，促进转型。第二，对于化石燃料补贴，负面效应在中等水平（1.34-15.46十亿美元）时不太明显，但在高水平时反弹。第三，在金融发展方面，影响呈倒U形：当信贷占GDP指标低于73.82%时，机器人进口促进转型，但高于此阈值时则抑制转型。第四，当研发强度超过1.67%时，由于技术锁定，机器人进口对转型不利。这些发现为发展中国家的转型提供了政策启示。

articles.title_en: The power of words: Central bank green communication and performance of energy sectors
articles.title_cn: 言语的力量：中央银行绿色沟通与能源行业表现
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effect of climate- and energy-related (green) communication by the European Central Bank (ECB) on the performance of renewable and fossil-based energy sectors. Using a sentence-embedding natural language processing model, we identify ECB speeches from 2015 to 2024 that explicitly reference both climate and energy themes, categorize them, and compute a green score for each. The analysis reveals prominent topics of climate and financial risk, and monetary policy and economic conditions, along with consistently positive and trust-related emotional cues. We then use high-frequency identification to estimate the effect of ECB green speeches on the return differential between green and brown energy sectors. The results show that ECB green communication positively and significantly affects sectoral relative returns, highlighting the communicative role of the ECB in influencing the relative performance of green and brown energy sectors. The results remain robust across a series of sensitivity analyses. The effect does not change significantly with the outbreak of the Russian–Ukrainian war or across ECB communication topics. We further find that ECB green speeches delivered by the President have a stronger effect on the return differential.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了欧洲中央银行（ECB）关于气候和能源相关（绿色）沟通对可再生能源和化石能源行业表现的影响。利用句子嵌入自然语言处理模型，我们识别了从2015年到2024年间欧洲央行明确提及气候和能源主题的演讲，对其进行分类，并为每次演讲计算绿色得分。分析揭示了气候与金融风险、货币政策与经济状况等突出主题，以及持续积极且与信任相关的情感线索。随后，我们使用高频识别方法来估计欧洲央行绿色演讲对绿色和棕色能源行业之间回报差异的影响。结果表明，欧洲央行的绿色沟通对行业相对回报产生了积极且显著的影响，凸显了欧洲央行在影响绿色和棕色能源行业相对表现方面的沟通作用。这一结果在一系列敏感性分析中保持稳健。该效应并未因俄乌战争的爆发或欧洲央行沟通主题的不同而发生显著变化。我们进一步发现，由行长发表的欧洲央行绿色演讲对回报差异的影响更强。

articles.title_en: Good wine needs no bush? Game analysis of the production behavior of carbon-labeled certified products
articles.title_cn: 好酒不怕巷子深？碳标签认证产品生产行为的博弈分析
articles.abstract_en: Carbon labels are important market-based instruments for conveying low-carbon information about products to consumers. However, in markets characterized by information asymmetry, consumers are also vulnerable to greenwashing claims, which raises concerns over whether greenwashing may crowd out the market benefits of carbon-labeled certified products. This study examines heterogeneous manufacturers' trade-offs between carbon labeling and greenwashing from a supply-side perspective. A duopoly Hotelling model and an evolutionary game are developed to identify the key factors and dynamic evolution of manufacturers' strategy choices. The results indicate that carbon label adoption depends on coordinated subsidies and regulations that overcome cost burdens and moderate greenwashing, shaped by manufacturer heterogeneity, market competition, and the green publicity effect. The policy focuses on coordinated subsidies, regulations, and specific industry and manufacturer interventions to address greenwashing, promote carbon labels, and ensure market stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 碳标签是向消费者传递产品低碳信息的重要市场化工具。然而，在信息不对称的市场中，消费者也容易受到绿色漂洗主张的影响，这引发了人们对绿色漂洗是否会挤占碳标签认证产品市场利益的担忧。本研究从供给侧视角考察了异质性制造商在碳标签与绿色漂洗之间的权衡。构建了双寡头霍特林模型和演化博弈模型，以识别制造商策略选择的关键因素和动态演化。结果表明，碳标签的采用依赖于协调的补贴和监管，这些措施需克服成本负担并适度抑制绿色漂洗，其效果受制造商异质性、市场竞争和绿色宣传效应的影响。政策重点在于协调补贴、监管以及针对特定行业和制造商的干预措施，以应对绿色漂洗、推广碳标签并确保市场稳定。

articles.title_en: The rise of climate risks: Evidence from firms’ expected default frequencies
articles.title_cn: 气候风险的上升：来自企业预期违约频率的证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the relationship between climate transition risk and credit risk by analyzing firms’ carbon emissions and Moody’s Expected Default Frequencies (EDFs). We document a structural shift following the Paris Agreement, after which absolute emissions became significantly associated with higher EDFs. By decomposing EDFs into their core components, we find that increased asset volatility is the main channel through which transition risk affects credit risk for high-emission firms. Our analysis provides evidence on the mechanisms linking climate transition risk to financial risk, showing that the rise in asset volatility is primarily driven by firms operating in sectors with greater consumer sensitivity and in regions characterized by more stringent climate policy environments. The results are robust to various model specifications and control variables, suggesting that climate-related financial risks are becoming increasingly relevant for credit markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过分析企业的碳排放和穆迪预期违约频率（EDFs）来研究气候转型风险与信用风险之间的关系。我们记录了《巴黎协定》之后的结构性转变，此后绝对排放量与更高的EDFs显著相关。通过将EDFs分解为其核心组成部分，我们发现资产波动性的增加是高排放企业转型风险影响信用风险的主要渠道。我们的分析提供了关于气候转型风险与金融风险之间联系机制的证据，表明资产波动性的上升主要由在消费者敏感度更高的行业以及气候政策环境更严格的地区运营的企业所驱动。结果对各种模型设定和控制变量均保持稳健，表明与气候相关的金融风险对信贷市场正变得越来越重要。

articles.title_en: Analyzing different energy transition patterns and their drivers using clustering and machine learning models: unveiling the role of digital technological innovation
articles.title_cn: 利用聚类与机器学习模型分析不同能源转型模式及其驱动因素：揭示数字技术创新的作用
articles.abstract_en: This study develops a dual-indicator framework combining renewable energy share (RE) and carbon emissions intensity (CE) to characterize heterogeneous energy transition patterns, addressing limitations of single-metric approaches that mask trade-offs between energy transformation and carbon emission. Employing a two-stage machine learning (ML) pipeline on city-year observations from 273 Chinese cities (2010−2021), we identify three distinct patterns through K-means clustering—Low (LET), Medium (MET), and High (HET) energy transition—each validated by significant inter-cluster distributional differences. Subsequently, an XGBoost classifier coupled with SHAP decomposition quantifies model-based feature contributions exhibiting pronounced nonlinear characteristics and context-dependencies. Network penetration emerges as the dominant yet contingent contributor, shifting from strongly inhibitory in the LET pattern to facilitative in the HET pattern. Digital technology innovation (DTI) exhibits threshold behavior, negatively associated with transition probability below the threshold but positively associated above. Against prior expectations, both fiscal expenditure and scientific investment exhibit negative SHAP contributions. These findings question the assumption of uniform technological benefits and highlight the risks of aggregation bias in urban-level analyses. The framework advances energy transition theory by quantifying previously qualitative concepts of system complementarities, offering actionable evidence for precision decarbonization strategies amid China's carbon neutrality commitments.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究构建了一个结合可再生能源占比（RE）与碳排放强度（CE）的双指标框架，用以刻画异质性的能源转型模式，弥补了单一指标方法掩盖能源转型与碳排放之间权衡关系的不足。采用两阶段机器学习（ML）流程，基于273个中国城市在2010年至2021年间的城市年度观测数据，通过K-means聚类识别出三种不同模式——低能源转型（LET）、中等能源转型（MET）和高能源转型（HET），每种模式均通过显著的组间分布差异得到验证。随后，结合XGBoost分类器与SHAP分解，量化了基于模型的特征贡献，这些贡献表现出显著的非线性特征和情境依赖性。网络渗透率成为主导但具有条件性的贡献因素，从LET模式中的强烈抑制作用转变为HET模式中的促进作用。数字技术创新（DTI）表现出阈值行为，在阈值以下与转型概率负相关，而在阈值以上则正相关。与先前预期相反，财政支出和科学投资均显示出负的SHAP贡献。这些发现质疑了技术收益一致性的假设，并强调了城市层面分析中聚合偏差的风险。该框架通过量化先前定性概念中的系统互补性，推进了能源转型理论，为中国碳中和承诺下的精准脱碳战略提供了可操作的证据。

articles.title_en: Energy price shocks in Europe and its impacts on vulnerable households: A demand system approach
articles.title_cn: 欧洲能源价格冲击及其对弱势家庭的影响：一种需求系统方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how European households, particularly low-income groups, adjusted to the surge in energy prices during the 2022–2023 energy crisis and the extent to which policy interventions mitigated the associated welfare losses. We estimate a household demand system using EU microdata and energy prices adjusted for government subsidies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了欧洲家庭，特别是低收入群体，如何在2022-2023年能源危机期间适应能源价格的飙升，以及政策干预在多大程度上减轻了相关的福利损失。我们使用欧盟微观数据和经政府补贴调整后的能源价格来估计家庭需求系统。

articles.title_en: How firms drive new energy system development: Evidence from Chinese listed energy companies
articles.title_cn: 企业如何推动新能源系统发展：来自中国上市能源公司的证据
articles.abstract_en: Clarifying the mechanisms that drive firms' participation in the development of the new energy system (NES) is essential for understanding corporate strategic behavior during the low-carbon transition and for supporting China's dual-carbon goals. Drawing on the “Principles-Elements-Functions” framework, this study constructs a theoretical model of the firm dynamic mechanism and employs mathematical modeling to characterize firms' behavioral and decision-making processes in NES development. Based on panel data from Chinese A-share-listed energy companies from 2010 to 2023, the empirical results indicate that profit growth, sustainable development, environmental regulation, and policy incentives are the key drivers of NES development, among which profit growth has the most pronounced effect. These drivers contribute to NES development through executive incentive, innovation, and structural adjustment channels. Further analysis shows that the driving effects are stronger among traditional energy firms and firms with higher-quality corporate governance. In addition, the interaction between profit growth and environmental regulation suggests that market incentives and government regulation jointly shape firms' engagement in NES development, reflecting the coordinated role of market and policy forces in advancing the low-carbon transition.
articles.abstract_cn: 阐明驱动企业参与新能源系统（NES）发展的机制，对于理解低碳转型中的企业战略行为以及支持中国的双碳目标至关重要。基于“原则-要素-功能”框架，本研究构建了企业动态机制的理论模型，并采用数学建模来刻画企业在新能源系统发展中的行为与决策过程。基于2010年至2023年中国A股上市能源公司的面板数据，实证结果表明，利润增长、可持续发展、环境规制和政策激励是新能源系统发展的关键驱动因素，其中利润增长的影响最为显著。这些驱动因素通过高管激励、创新和结构调整渠道促进新能源系统发展。进一步分析显示，在传统能源企业和公司治理质量较高的企业中，驱动效应更强。此外，利润增长与环境规制之间的交互作用表明，市场激励和政府规制共同塑造了企业对新能源系统发展的参与，反映了市场与政策力量在推进低碳转型中的协同作用。

articles.title_en: And yet it moves: A study of natural gas consumption in Italy at the turn of the 2022 energy crisis
articles.title_cn: 然而它仍在移动：2022年能源危机之际意大利天然气消费研究
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents the first econometric analysis of Italian residential natural gas consumption at the turn of the 2022 energy crisis. Using daily data from 2012 to 2025 and applying the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) and Error Correction Model (ECM) methodologies, we investigate how the unprecedented price shocks following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine affected Italian households’ consumption patterns. Our analysis demonstrates that the crisis triggered a persistent transformation in consumers’ behavior that extends beyond the immediate crisis period. Before December 2021, natural gas demand was essentially price-inelastic. However, the energy crisis altered this relationship, with price elasticity increasing from virtually zero to 0.34 by 2023 — a transformation that persists even as prices have moderated. The elasticity is even larger (up to 1.90) when we refer to the price-responsive component of demand. Moreover, the decomposition of total demand into heating and baseload components reveals that space heating demand served as the primary adjustment mechanism during the crisis. We estimate approximately 11.9 billion cubic meters in savings between 2022 and 2025, translating to 13 billion euros in financial savings. Finally, we find evidence that the lockdowns during the Covid-19 pandemic and the policy measures introduced in 2022–2023 to incentivize gas savings had a limited effect on gas consumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文首次对2022年能源危机之际意大利住宅天然气消费进行了计量经济学分析。利用2012年至2025年的日度数据，并应用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）和误差修正模型（ECM）方法，我们研究了俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后前所未有的价格冲击如何影响意大利家庭的消费模式。我们的分析表明，这场危机引发了消费者行为的持久转变，这种转变超出了危机直接时期。在2021年十二月之前，天然气需求基本上是价格无弹性的。然而，能源危机改变了这一关系，价格弹性从几乎为零增加到0.34年的2023——即使价格回落，这一转变仍然持续。当我们参考需求中价格响应部分时，弹性甚至更大（高达1.90）。此外，将总需求分解为供暖和基本负荷部分揭示，空间供暖需求在危机期间是主要的调整机制。我们估计11.9年至2022年间节省了约2025亿立方米，相当于13亿欧元的财务节省。最后，我们发现Covid-19大流行期间的封锁以及2022-2023年为激励天然气节约而引入的政策措施对天然气消费的影响有限。

articles.title_en: Climate policy in the shadows: Investigate the unintended consequences of uncertainty on green innovation vitality in China
articles.title_cn: 阴影下的气候政策：探究不确定性对中国绿色创新活力的意外后果
articles.abstract_en: This research employs high-dimensional fixed-effects model to investigates the effect of climate policy uncertainty on firms' green innovation vitality and its mechanism role using data from Chinese listed companies from 2000 to 2022. Our empirical findings indicate that climate policy uncertainty hampers green innovation vitality of listed firms, and rising climate policy uncertainty negatively affects green innovation vitality. The results from heterogeneity analyses reveal that this negative effect is significant in Eastern and Central, SOEs and manufacturing firms. The mechanism analysis further indicates that climate policy uncertainty exerts an inhibitory effect on firms' green innovation vitality by intensifying corporate financing constraints and reducing green governance level. The inhibitory impact of Chinese climate policy uncertainty on green innovation vitality is moderated by digital transformation of companies and green funding incentives. The results of the double hurdle model suggest that once firms have decided to enter the field of green innovation, this decision is less likely to be altered by changes in climate policy uncertainty. However, among firms that have already chosen to engage in green innovation, heightened climate policy uncertainty significantly diminishes firms' green innovation vitality.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究采用高维固定效应模型，利用2000年至2022年中国上市公司的数据，考察了气候政策不确定性对企业绿色创新活力的影响及其机制作用。我们的实证研究结果表明，气候政策不确定性抑制了上市公司的绿色创新活力，且气候政策不确定性的上升对绿色创新活力产生负面影响。异质性分析结果显示，这种负面影响在东部和中部地区、国有企业及制造业企业中显著。机制分析进一步表明，气候政策不确定性通过加剧企业融资约束和降低绿色治理水平，对企业的绿色创新活力产生抑制作用。中国气候政策不确定性对绿色创新活力的抑制影响受到企业数字化转型和绿色资金激励的调节。双门槛模型的结果表明，一旦企业决定进入绿色创新领域，这一决策不太可能因气候政策不确定性的变化而改变。然而，在已经选择参与绿色创新的企业中，气候政策不确定性的加剧显著降低了企业的绿色创新活力。

articles.title_en: Environmental policy stringency and wind power investment: Evidence on policy design and institutional heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 环境政策严格度与风电投资：政策设计与制度异质性的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study examines how environmental policy stringency influences wind power deployment using annual additions to installed wind capacity, a flow-based measure that captures contemporaneous investment responses. Using panel data for 34 OECD and six major non-OECD economies over 2001–2020, the analysis evaluates both the overall effect of policy stringency and the roles of different policy instruments. The Environmental Policy Stringency (EPS) index is decomposed into direct instruments, which affect project-level incentives, and indirect instruments, which operate through broader price and regulatory channels. The results show that stricter environmental policy is positively associated with wind capacity additions, although its importance varies over time. Policy effects are stronger in earlier stages of diffusion, while declining technology costs become more important in later periods. Direct policy instruments have a strong and robust impact on investment, whereas indirect measures are weaker and less consistent. The effectiveness of policy also depends on institutional context. Direct instruments are more effective in OECD economies, but can also perform strongly in non-OECD settings when supported by credible implementation and strong institutional capacity. These findings highlight the importance of policy design, sequencing, and institutional conditions in driving renewable energy investment.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用年度新增风电装机容量（一种能够捕捉当期投资反应的流量指标）来考察环境政策严格度如何影响风电部署。基于2001-2020年间34个OECD国家和六个主要非OECD经济体的面板数据，分析评估了政策严格度的总体效应以及不同政策工具的作用。环境政策严格度（EPS）指数被分解为直接影响项目层面激励的直接工具和通过更广泛的价格与监管渠道发挥作用的间接工具。结果表明，更严格的环境政策与风电装机容量增加呈正相关，尽管其重要性随时间变化。政策效应在扩散早期阶段更强，而技术成本下降在后期阶段变得更加重要。直接政策工具对投资具有强烈且稳健的影响，而间接措施的影响较弱且一致性较差。政策的有效性还取决于制度背景。直接工具在OECD经济体中更为有效，但在有可信执行和强大制度能力支持的非OECD环境中也能表现出色。这些发现强调了政策设计、顺序安排和制度条件在推动可再生能源投资中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Energy efficiency and energy rebound across heterogeneous technologies: A global analysis
articles.title_cn: 异质性技术下的能源效率与能源回弹：一项全球分析
articles.abstract_en: Cross-country studies of energy efficiency and rebound effects typically impose a common production frontier and therefore ignore technological heterogeneity across countries. This paper relaxes that assumption by combining latent class stochastic frontier analysis with a rebound-adjusted stochastic energy-demand frontier. Using an unbalanced panel of 85 countries over 1996–2021, we first identify latent technology regimes and then estimate energy efficiency and rebound effects for the pooled sample and within each class. The results show that technological heterogeneity is empirically important. The homogeneous model masks differences in the determinants of energy demand and rebound effects and produces estimates that are more sensitive to aggregation. By contrast, the latent class model identifies two broad regimes in frontier behavior. Class 1, which includes many emerging industrializers and lower- and middle-income economies, shows lower average energy efficiency and slightly weaker rebound effects, whereas Class 2, which includes many advanced and upper-middle-income economies, exhibits higher efficiency but also somewhat stronger rebound effects. We also find evidence supporting a Rebound Kuznets Curve: energy rebound is lowest at low-income levels, rises significantly during the middle of the income distribution, and declines again at higher income levels. These findings suggest that the design of energy-efficiency policy should account for both technological heterogeneity and differences in development stage.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于能源效率和回弹效应的跨国研究通常设定一个共同的生产前沿，因此忽略了各国之间的技术异质性。本文通过将潜在类别随机前沿分析与回弹调整的随机能源需求前沿相结合，放宽了这一假设。利用1996-2021年间85个国家的不平衡面板数据，我们首先识别潜在的技术体制，然后估计合并样本及每个类别内的能源效率和回弹效应。结果表明，技术异质性在实证上具有重要意义。同质模型掩盖了能源需求决定因素和回弹效应的差异，并产生了对聚合更为敏感的估计。相比之下，潜在类别模型识别出前沿行为中的两种广泛体制。类别1包含许多新兴工业化国家以及中低收入经济体，显示出较低的平均能源效率和略弱的回弹效应，而类别2包含许多发达国家和中高收入经济体，表现出较高的效率但也具有稍强的回弹效应。我们还发现了支持回弹库兹涅茨曲线的证据：能源回弹在低收入水平时最低，在收入分布中间阶段显著上升，并在较高收入水平时再次下降。这些发现表明，能源效率政策的设计应同时考虑技术异质性和发展阶段差异。

articles.title_en: Dynamic game analysis of coupled medium- to long-term and spot electricity markets under high renewable penetration
articles.title_cn: 高可再生能源渗透下中长期与现货电力市场耦合的动态博弈分析
articles.abstract_en: As the share of renewable energy in power systems continues to increase and demand-side volatility and uncertainty intensify, achieving coordinated decision-making and intertemporal alignment between medium- to long-term electricity market and electricity spot (ES) market has become a key challenge for resource allocation and risk management under high renewable penetration. To address this issue, this study develops a dynamic game model that couples medium- to long-term electricity and electricity spot markets and explicitly characterizes the decision-making behavior of multiple market participants, including wind generators, conventional generators, and the grid company. ES market bidding is formulated as a Bellman equation and solved using Approximate Dynamic Programming with an online actor–critic reinforcement learning algorithm. In addition, an Input Convex Neural Network combined with inverse optimization is used to capture the reaction mapping from contract parameters to spot market revenues. On the basis, the ADMM algorithm is further applied to coordinate contract signing and ES bidding strategies across multiple participants and to obtain the corresponding market equilibrium. Numerical results show that: uncertainty in renewable generation is shifting electricity spot price formation from demand-side dominance toward supply-side dominance, giving rise to a characteristic “load-follows-resource” pattern; system load still plays a decisive role in shaping the generation mix and the scale of contract lock-in, highlighting the indispensable capacity and balancing value of conventional generators under high-load conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着可再生能源在电力系统中的占比持续增加以及需求侧波动性和不确定性的加剧，实现中长期电力市场与电力现货（ES）市场之间的协调决策和跨期对齐已成为高可再生能源渗透下资源配置和风险管理的关键挑战。为解决这一问题，本研究构建了一个耦合中长期电力市场与电力现货市场的动态博弈模型，并明确刻画了包括风电机组、常规机组和电网公司在内的多个市场参与者的决策行为。现货市场竞价被建模为贝尔曼方程，并采用结合在线演员-评论家强化学习算法的近似动态规划进行求解。此外，结合逆优化的输入凸神经网络被用于捕捉从合约参数到现货市场收益的反应映射。在此基础上，进一步应用ADMM算法协调多个参与者之间的合约签订和现货竞价策略，并获得相应的市场均衡。数值结果表明：可再生能源发电的不确定性正在将电力现货价格形成从需求侧主导转向供给侧主导，从而产生一种特征性的“负荷跟随资源”模式；系统负荷在塑造发电组合和合约锁定规模方面仍起决定性作用，凸显了高负荷条件下常规机组不可或缺的容量和平衡价值。

articles.title_en: Smart meters and energy poverty: Unintended consequences of precision monitoring
articles.title_cn: 智能电表与能源贫困：精准监测的意外后果
articles.abstract_en: Smart meters are widely used to enhance energy efficiency and electricity management through precision monitoring. However, many residents are concerned that the installation of smart meters may lead to higher electricity expenditure. While existing studies suggest that smart meters enhance consumers' energy-saving awareness and induce reduction in energy consumption, their impact on vulnerable consumers—particularly rural and low-income households—remains underexplored. This study examines whether smart meters have varying impacts on energy use in the Chinese context, based on the data from the Chinese General Social Survey (CGSS). The findings reveal that smart meters not only fail to achieve energy-saving effects but also result in increased electricity expenditures across various groups, especially among vulnerable consumers such as rural and low-income households. Further analysis highlights that smart meters reveal previously underestimated energy poverty, underscoring the need to protect vulnerable consumers from rising energy burdens during the energy transition. These insights contribute to the broader discussion on the social implications of energy policies, emphasizing the need for more inclusive approaches when implementing smart technologies globally.
articles.abstract_cn: 智能电表通过精准监测被广泛用于提高能源效率和电力管理。然而，许多居民担心安装智能电表可能导致电费支出增加。尽管现有研究表明智能电表增强了消费者的节能意识并促使能源消耗减少，但其对弱势消费者——尤其是农村和低收入家庭——的影响仍未得到充分探讨。本研究基于中国综合社会调查（CGSS）的数据，考察了智能电表在中国情境下是否对能源使用产生不同影响。研究发现，智能电表不仅未能实现节能效果，反而导致各群体的电费支出增加，尤其是在农村和低收入家庭等弱势消费者中。进一步分析强调，智能电表揭示了先前被低估的能源贫困，凸显了在能源转型过程中保护弱势消费者免受能源负担上升影响的必要性。这些见解有助于更广泛地讨论能源政策的社会影响，强调在全球实施智能技术时需要采取更具包容性的方法。

articles.title_en: Looking for the twin deficits in a dollarized oil-exporting economy
articles.title_cn: 在美元化的石油出口经济中寻找孪生赤字
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of fiscal policy shocks on the trade balance and the real exchange rate in a dollarized, oil-exporting economy. Using data from Ecuador, we estimate a Bayesian Vector Autoregression (BVAR) model that properly characterizes the role of oil revenues in the transmission of fiscal policy. We simulate policy scenarios and test the twin deficits hypothesis. We find that fiscal deficits driven by increases in government consumption or tax cuts weaken the trade balance, providing evidence for the twin deficits hypothesis under certain policy configurations. Positive oil revenue shocks also lead to a deterioration of the non-oil trade balance. The real exchange rate appreciates in response to both government consumption and investment shocks, while it depreciates following an oil revenue shock. Since government spending and oil revenues often move together in oil-exporting countries, the divergence in their effects raises important challenges for policymakers seeking to maintain external balance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了财政政策冲击对贸易余额和实际汇率的影响，在一个美元化的石油出口经济中。利用厄瓜多尔的数据，我们估计了一个贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型，该模型恰当地刻画了石油收入在财政政策传导中的作用。我们模拟了政策情景并检验了孪生赤字假说。我们发现，由政府消费增加或减税驱动的财政赤字削弱了贸易余额，为特定政策配置下的孪生赤字假说提供了证据。正的石油收入冲击也导致非石油贸易余额的恶化。实际汇率对政府消费和投资冲击均作出升值反应，而对石油收入冲击则贬值。由于在石油出口国家政府支出和石油收入经常同步变动，它们效应的差异为寻求维持外部平衡的政策制定者提出了重要挑战。

articles.title_en: Navigating just energy transitions: A DSGE analysis of renewable portfolio standards and technology innovations
articles.title_cn: 导航公正能源转型：可再生能源组合标准与技术创新的DSGE分析
articles.abstract_en: As the global energy landscape shifts toward sustainability, the Renewable Portfolio Standards (RPS) policy has emerged as a crucial tool for promoting renewable energy development. However, its potential impact on energy justice remains understudied. This paper aims to investigate the effects of RPS and energy-specific technology innovations on just energy transitions using a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model. We construct a nine-sector DSGE model incorporating the RPS policy, energy storage, pollution-related health effects, and multiple technology shocks, and then conduct steady-state comparisons, impulse response analysis, and welfare evaluation in sequence. The results indicate that: (i) From a general equilibrium perspective, the implication of RPS on the just energy transition is quota-stringency dependent. (ii) The RPS policy induces a welfare divergence pattern between heterogeneous households. (iii) Compared with the supply-side RPS, the demand-side RPS provides a stronger demand-pull for renewable electricity generation and is more conducive to advancing a just energy transition. This study provides novel insights for policymakers on leveraging RPS and technology innovations to facilitate just energy transitions, contributing to the growing body of literature on navigating uncertainties in energy economics and policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着全球能源格局向可持续性转变，可再生能源组合标准（RPS）政策已成为促进可再生能源发展的关键工具。然而，其对能源公正的潜在影响仍未得到充分研究。本文旨在利用动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，研究RPS和能源特定技术创新对公正能源转型的影响。我们构建了一个包含RPS政策、能源储存、污染相关健康效应以及多种技术冲击的九部门DSGE模型，并依次进行稳态比较、脉冲响应分析和福利评估。结果表明：（i）从一般均衡视角看，RPS对公正能源转型的影响取决于配额严格程度。（ii）RPS政策在异质性家庭之间引发了福利分化模式。（iii）与供给侧RPS相比，需求侧RPS为可再生能源发电提供了更强的需求拉动，更有利于推进公正能源转型。本研究为政策制定者利用RPS和技术创新促进公正能源转型提供了新颖见解，为能源经济学与政策中不确定性导航的日益增长的文献做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: Demand-side energy efficiency, demand response, and carbon tax
articles.title_cn: 需求侧能源效率、需求响应与碳税
articles.abstract_en: The growing penetration of renewable energy sources has increased the need for flexibility in power systems to manage supply-side fluctuations. Demand response (DR) plays a key role in decarbonizing electricity balancing operations, serving as a flexible and low-carbon alternative to conventional thermal power generation to address supply–demand imbalances. This paper demonstrates how demand-side energy use efficiency affects DR and total CO2 emissions in electricity markets. We analyze a model consisting of a day-ahead market and balancing operations with a focus on CO2 emissions. The marginal cost of DR corresponds to the marginal utility of electricity consumption. Enhanced energy efficiency increases the marginal cost of DR, thereby increasing thermal power generation in the balancing phase. Thus, an improvement in demand-side energy efficiency can increase emissions during the balancing operation while decreasing emissions attributed to the day-ahead market. Counterintuitively, our analysis reveals that improved energy efficiency could increase total CO2 emissions when the emission factor of conventional power generation in the day-ahead market is sufficiently small. As energy efficiency improves, the carbon tax rate needs to be raised to deter such perverse effects, expanding the use of DR in the balancing period.
articles.abstract_cn: 可再生能源渗透率的不断提高增加了电力系统管理供给侧波动的灵活性需求。需求响应（DR）在电力平衡操作的脱碳中扮演关键角色，作为传统火力发电的灵活低碳替代方案，以解决供需失衡问题。本文论证了需求侧能源使用效率如何影响电力市场中的需求响应和总二氧化碳排放。我们分析了一个由日前市场和平衡操作组成的模型，重点关注二氧化碳排放。需求响应的边际成本对应于电力消费的边际效用。能源效率的提高增加了需求响应的边际成本，从而增加了平衡阶段的热力发电量。因此，需求侧能源效率的改善可能增加平衡操作期间的排放，同时减少归因于日前市场的排放。与直觉相反，我们的分析揭示，当日前市场中常规发电的排放因子足够小时，能源效率的提高可能增加总二氧化碳排放。随着能源效率的提高，需要提高碳税率以阻止这种反常效应，扩大平衡期间需求响应的使用。

articles.title_en: The decarbonization effect of data elements in the supply chain
articles.title_cn: 供应链中数据要素的脱碳效应
articles.abstract_en: In advancing the synergy between carbon neutrality objectives and digital transformation, elucidating how data elements contribute to decarbonizing supply chains is crucial for reinforcing the role of emerging production factors and shaping innovative models of environmental regulation. Drawing on panel data of Chinese A-share listed firms during 2009–2022, this study constructs a dataset at the upstream supplier–downstream firm–year level and empirically investigates the supply-chain-based low-carbon effects of data elements and their underlying mechanisms. First, this study innovatively measures the development level of data elements within enterprises from the perspective of the data value chain by leveraging a Large Language Model. Second, empirical evidence based on supply-chain-level data indicates that data elements exert a supply chain decarbonization effect. Third, knowledge spillover, carbon neutrality technology innovation, improved supply chain finance, and human capital upgrading constitute important pathways through which this effect operates. This study yields policy insights into how to unlock the value of data elements and foster the coordinated advancement of supply chain digitalization and the green transition.
articles.abstract_cn: 在推进碳中和目标与数字化转型协同发展的过程中，阐明数据要素如何助力供应链脱碳，对于强化新兴生产要素的作用和塑造环境监管的创新模式至关重要。利用2009-2022年中国A股上市公司的面板数据，本研究构建了上游供应商-下游企业-年度层面的数据集，并实证考察了数据要素基于供应链的低碳效应及其内在机制。首先，本研究创新性地从数据价值链视角，借助大型语言模型衡量企业内部数据要素的发展水平。其次，基于供应链层面数据的实证证据表明，数据要素具有供应链脱碳效应。第三，知识溢出、碳中和技术创新、供应链金融改善和人力资本升级构成了这一效应发挥作用的重要途径。本研究为如何释放数据要素价值、促进供应链数字化与绿色转型协同推进提供了政策启示。

articles.title_en: Endogenous elasticity of substitution as a catalyst for Green transition: Evidence from Bangladesh, Nigeria and China
articles.title_cn: 内生替代弹性作为绿色转型的催化剂：来自孟加拉国、尼日利亚和中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: How to optimize environmental policies supporting industrial Green transition and decarbonization strategies at the lowest economic cost is a major challenge for emerging economies. As a key parameter in evaluating the progress of economic Green transition, the elasticity of substitution between dirty and clean energy significantly affects the formulation of optimal environmental policies. In this study, we select Bangladesh, Nigeria, and China as experimental subjects and relax the assumption of fixed substitution elasticity, we construct a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model incorporating endogenous substitution elasticity to capture the dynamic response trends of different environmental policies. The findings reveal a virtuous cycle driven by endogenous substitution elasticity, which amplifies environmental policies and creates a synergistic effect with green technological progress, accelerating the green transition.
articles.abstract_cn: 如何以最低的经济成本优化支持工业绿色转型和脱碳战略的环境政策，是新兴经济体面临的主要挑战。作为评估经济绿色转型进展的关键参数，肮脏能源与清洁能源之间的替代弹性显著影响最优环境政策的制定。在本研究中，我们选取孟加拉国、尼日利亚和中国作为实验对象，放宽固定替代弹性的假设，构建了一个包含内生替代弹性的动态随机一般均衡模型，以捕捉不同环境政策的动态响应趋势。研究结果揭示了由内生替代弹性驱动的良性循环，该循环放大了环境政策，并与绿色技术进步产生协同效应，加速了绿色转型。

articles.title_en: Renewable, fossil fuel, and nuclear energy responses to global shocks: Lessons from China and the United States
articles.title_cn: 可再生能源、化石燃料和核能对全球冲击的响应：来自中国和美国的启示
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates how U.S. primary energy production and Chinese electricity generation from fossil fuels, renewables, and nuclear sources react to geopolitical risk (GPR) and global economic policy uncertainty (GEPU) shocks. Using a Bayesian Vector Autoregressive (BVAR) model for the period 1997–2025, the estimates reveal how these countries accommodate the energy trilemma in the face of common shocks. The results show that the U.S. expands fossil fuel and nuclear production, while China increases renewable energy in response to GPR shocks. Based on impulse response functions, the response in the U.S. is likely driven by investment adjustments and a reorientation of energy policy, whereas in China the short-run production changes appear to reflect mechanical adjustments. However, variance decomposition results indicate persistent long-term effects in both countries, suggesting that installed capacity expansion, investment adjustments, and energy policy reorientation may drive changes in energy production. Given their national characteristics, the findings suggest that the U.S. prioritizes energy security and affordability in uncertain times, whereas China emphasizes the sustainability pillar of the energy trilemma. The main results remain robust when considering global economic policy uncertainty (GEPU) shocks, although some differences emerge: the U.S. increases its renewable energy production, while China decreases its electricity generation from fossil fuels. The empirical models capture effects of uncertainty shocks on energy over a 10-year horizon in both countries, indicating potential investment adjustments and changes in installed capacity. In other words, the energy trilemma is sensitive to the type of shock. This paper contributes to the literature by providing a comprehensive view of how renewable, nuclear, and fossil fuel energy respond simultaneously to common global shocks within the framework of the energy trilemma.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了美国一次能源生产以及中国来自化石燃料、可再生能源和核能的电力生产如何对地缘政治风险（GPR）和全球经济政策不确定性（GEPU）冲击做出反应。使用1997-2025年期间的贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型，估计结果揭示了这些国家在面对共同冲击时如何应对能源三难困境。结果显示，美国扩大了化石燃料和核能生产，而中国则增加了可再生能源以应对GPR冲击。基于脉冲响应函数，美国的响应可能由投资调整和能源政策的重新定位驱动，而中国的短期生产变化似乎反映了机械性调整。然而，方差分解结果表明两国均存在持续的长期效应，表明装机容量扩张、投资调整和能源政策重新定位可能推动能源生产的变化。鉴于其国家特征，研究结果表明，美国在不确定时期优先考虑能源安全和可负担性，而中国则强调能源三难困境的可持续性支柱。在考虑全球经济政策不确定性（GEPU）冲击时，主要结果保持稳健，但出现了一些差异：美国增加了其可再生能源生产，而中国减少了其化石燃料发电量。实证模型捕捉了不确定性冲击对两国能源在10年期内的影响，表明潜在的投资调整和装机容量变化。换言之，能源三难困境对冲击类型敏感。本文通过提供可再生能源、核能和化石燃料能源在能源三难困境框架内如何同时响应共同全球冲击的全面视角，为文献做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: Electricity price convergence in Europe: Geographical versus generation structure proximity
articles.title_cn: 欧洲电价趋同：地理邻近性与发电结构邻近性
articles.abstract_en: This study examines factors associated with the convergence of electricity prices in Europe between 2016 and 2024, with a focus on geographical and structural aspects. The analysis covers 23 countries and employs two convergence indicators derived from hourly day-ahead market data. The factors are examined across four categories: transmission infrastructure, generation mix, system size, and regional affiliation. Machine learning techniques, specifically random forest models, are applied to the entire time period and to two sub-periods (2016–2019 and 2020–2024) to evaluate how the relative importance of these factors has changed over time.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了2016年至2024年间与欧洲电价趋同相关的因素，重点关注地理和结构方面。分析覆盖23个国家，并采用基于小时级日前市场数据的两个趋同指标。这些因素分为四类进行考察：输电基础设施、发电组合、系统规模和区域归属。机器学习技术，特别是随机森林模型，被应用于整个时间段以及两个子时期（2016-2019年和2020-2024年），以评估这些因素的相对重要性随时间的变化。

articles.title_en: Bitcoin mining as supply-side flexibility in Irish wind energy integration
articles.title_cn: 比特币挖矿作为爱尔兰风能整合中的供给侧灵活性
articles.abstract_en: Ireland recorded 10.1% of available wind generation (1.3 TWh) as dispatch-down in 2024, with 2025 data showing a further rise to 11.4% as capacity additions continue to outpace transmission investment. This paper evaluates co-located Bitcoin mining as a supply-side flexibility mechanism for absorbing curtailed energy under Irish Single Electricity Market conditions. Using hourly 2024 data for a modelled 100 MW wind farm, a deterministic revenue-maximisation model is solved across six scenarios spanning 0–90 MW of mining capacity and two ASIC hardware generations. A 20 MW installation of current-generation hardware (16 J/TH) absorbs 83% of annual dispatch-down energy, raises total system revenue by 32%, and increases the effective capacity factor from 29% to 32%; scaling to 30 MW raises absorption to 93%. Legacy hardware at 98 J/TH is uneconomic under all 2024 scenarios. Investment viability depends on the magnitude of the spread between Bitcoin price and network hashrate growth rates rather than on the absolute price level.
articles.abstract_cn: 爱尔兰在2024年记录了可用风力发电量的10.1%（1.3太瓦时）作为调度下调，2025年的数据显示，随着容量增加持续超过输电投资，这一比例进一步上升至11.4%。本文评估了在爱尔兰单一电力市场条件下，共址比特币挖矿作为吸收削减能源的供给侧灵活性机制的潜力。使用2024年一个模拟的100兆瓦风电场的每小时数据，求解了一个确定性收入最大化模型，涵盖六个情景，挖矿容量从0到90兆瓦，并涉及两代ASIC硬件。一个20兆瓦的当前一代硬件（16焦耳/太哈希）装置吸收了年度调度下调能源的83%，使系统总收入提高32%，并将有效容量因子从29%提升至32%；扩展到30兆瓦时，吸收率提高至93%。在98焦耳/太哈希的旧一代硬件在所有2024年情景下均不经济。投资可行性取决于比特币价格与网络哈希率增长率之间的差距大小，而非绝对价格水平。

articles.title_en: Foreign divestment as a catalyst for indigenous innovation and manufacturing upgrading: Evidence from China's power sector
articles.title_cn: 外资撤资作为本土创新与制造业升级的催化剂：来自中国电力行业的证据
articles.abstract_en: The existing literature on the impact of economic decoupling is inconclusive and lacks sufficient empirical evidence. This paper examines the impact of economic decoupling on green productivity of power utilities, focusing on the foreign divestment (FD) activities in China's power industry from 1999 to 2013. The study uses a panel dataset compiled from several databases, including industrial enterprise data, regional macro data, customs data, firm patent data, and manufacturing emissions data. To identify the direct impact of FD, we construct a shock intensity indicator of FD using the base-period foreign investment share of power utilities and regional FD events. Additionally, an input-output table is used to construct an industry dependence indicator to identify spillovers to the manufacturing sector. The findings provide robust empirical evidence that FD served as a significant driver of accelerated productivity growth in the power sector. The growth can be attributed to two factors: indigenous innovation in power utilities and import substitution in manufacturing. The acceleration of indigenous innovation can be attributed to the demand for risk hedging spurred by FD, while the strengthening of domestic manufacturing capabilities stems from a market filling effect. These findings underscore the importance of strengthening indigenous innovation and domestic manufacturing to mitigate and reverse the adverse impacts of economic decoupling, thereby illuminating how domestic firms can navigate such challenges.
articles.abstract_cn: 现有关于经济脱钩影响的文献尚无定论，且缺乏充分的实证证据。本文考察了经济脱钩对电力公用事业绿色生产率的影响，重点关注1999年至2013年间中国电力行业的外资撤资活动。研究使用了从多个数据库汇编的面板数据集，包括工业企业数据、区域宏观数据、海关数据、企业专利数据和制造业排放数据。为识别外资撤资的直接效应，我们利用电力公用事业基期外资份额和区域外资撤资事件构建了外资撤资冲击强度指标。此外，使用投入产出表构建行业依赖指标，以识别对制造业部门的溢出效应。研究结果提供了稳健的实证证据，表明外资撤资是电力行业生产率增长加速的重要驱动因素。这一增长可归因于两个因素：电力公用事业的本土创新和制造业的进口替代。本土创新的加速可归因于外资撤资引发的风险对冲需求，而国内制造业能力的增强则源于市场填补效应。这些发现强调了加强本土创新和国内制造业以缓解和逆转经济脱钩不利影响的重要性，从而阐明了国内企业如何应对此类挑战。

articles.title_en: Firm characteristics, climate policy shocks, and climate risk exposures: Evidence of feedback loops from a quasi-experiment in GCC countries
articles.title_cn: 企业特征、气候政策冲击与气候风险暴露：来自海湾合作委员会国家准实验的反馈循环证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine how external policy shocks and firm characteristics affect firms' environment-related transition risk exposure (TRE) and physical risk exposure (PRE) in Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries, emphasizing feedback effects among these variables using a dataset of 775 firms from 2005 to 2024. First, we estimate transition and physical risk exposure using the Fama-French five-factor model augmented with global transition and physical risk indices. To disentangle climate-specific exposures from energy-price dynamics, we construct both standard (FF5) and oil-controlled measures, capturing two distinct sources of climate risk in GCC countries. Using seemingly unrelated regressions and system GMM, we document feedback loops between climate risk exposures and firm responses across investment, innovation, and sustainability channels. Firms expand investment under rising transition risk but contract it under physical risk, revealing distinct behavioral mechanisms. When both risks are present jointly, transition risk dominates investment and innovation responses. We also apply a quasi-natural experiment framework to assess the impact of the 2021 introduction of climate policies in the GCC on firms' climate-related risk exposure, using 3297 listed Chinese firms as the control group. We find that GCC firms face greater transition risks but lower physical risks following the 2021 climate initiatives in the GCC. Triple difference-in-differences analysis reveals that investor preference and regulatory pressure serve as the dominant transmission channels.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了外部政策冲击和企业特征如何影响海湾合作委员会（GCC）国家企业的环境相关转型风险暴露（TRE）和物理风险暴露（PRE），并利用2005年至2024年间775家企业的数据集，强调了这些变量之间的反馈效应。首先，我们使用Fama-French五因子模型，并加入全球转型和物理风险指数，来估计转型和物理风险暴露。为了将气候特定暴露与能源价格动态区分开来，我们构建了标准（FF5）和石油控制两种度量，捕捉GCC国家气候风险的两个不同来源。使用似不相关回归和系统GMM，我们记录了气候风险暴露与企业通过投资、创新和可持续性渠道的响应之间的反馈循环。企业在转型风险上升时扩大投资，但在物理风险下收缩投资，揭示了不同的行为机制。当两种风险同时存在时，转型风险主导投资和创新响应。我们还应用准自然实验框架，评估2021年GCC引入气候政策对企业气候相关风险暴露的影响，使用3297家中国上市公司作为对照组。我们发现，在2021年GCC气候倡议之后，GCC企业面临更高的转型风险，但物理风险较低。三重差分分析显示，投资者偏好和监管压力是主要的传导渠道。

articles.title_en: The pains of transition: Coal Price, grid constraints, and new energy investment efficiency
articles.title_cn: 转型之痛：煤炭价格、电网约束与新能源投资效率
articles.abstract_en: China's energy transition is proceeding under continued coal-system dependence. As a result, renewable investment remains exposed to coal-market turbulence through electricity-system balancing, financing conditions, and grid absorption constraints. These frictions capture an important dimension of the “pains of transition” in China's move toward a more renewable-based power system. Using panel data on Chinese A-share listed new energy firms from 2006 to 2024, this paper examines how coal price uncertainty affects corporate investment inefficiency. We first document a positive benchmark association between continuous coal price uncertainty and firm-level investment inefficiency. To strengthen identification, we then implement a shock-centered difference-in-differences design around the 2021 coal-market shock, in which treatment intensity is defined by firms' pre-shock industry coal exposure. The results show that the shock significantly increased investment inefficiency among more coal-exposed firms. We further show that this effect is amplified in provinces with tighter renewable absorption constraints, consistent with a grid-side physical amplification channel. Second, we estimate mechanism-consistent triple-difference specifications and find that the post-shock effect is stronger for firms with tighter ex-ante financing constraints, greater ex-ante information asymmetry, and higher ex-ante operational risk. Third, heterogeneity analyses further indicate that the adverse effect is more pronounced among state-owned enterprises, start-up firms, upstream and midstream firms, firms without industry–university–research collaboration, and firms located in highly marketized regions. Overall, the findings show that coal-market turbulence distorts new energy firm's capital allocation during China's energy transition and highlight the importance of stabilizing both market expectations and grid integration conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国的能源转型在持续依赖煤炭系统的背景下进行。因此，可再生能源投资仍然通过电力系统平衡、融资条件和电网消纳约束而暴露于煤炭市场波动之中。这些摩擦捕捉了中国向更基于可再生能源的电力系统转型过程中“转型之痛”的一个重要维度。利用2006年至2024年中国A股上市新能源企业的面板数据，本文考察了煤炭价格不确定性如何影响企业投资无效率。我们首先记录了连续煤炭价格不确定性与企业层面投资无效率之间的正向基准关联。为了加强识别，我们随后围绕2021年煤炭市场冲击实施了一个以冲击为中心的差分中差分设计，其中处理强度由企业冲击前的行业煤炭暴露度定义。结果表明，该冲击显著增加了煤炭暴露度较高企业的投资无效率。我们进一步表明，这种效应在可再生能源消纳约束更严格的省份被放大，这与电网侧的物理放大渠道一致。其次，我们估计了机制一致的三重差分规格，并发现冲击后的效应对于事前融资约束更紧、事前信息不对称程度更高以及事前运营风险更高的企业更为强烈。第三，异质性分析进一步表明，不利效应在国有企业、初创企业、上游和中游企业、无产学研合作的企业以及位于高市场化地区的企业中更为显著。总体而言，研究结果表明，在中国能源转型期间，煤炭市场波动扭曲了新能源企业的资本配置，并强调了稳定市场预期和电网整合条件的重要性。

articles.title_en: Value of incidental heat in buildings
articles.title_cn: 建筑中附带热量的价值
articles.abstract_en: Electricity use is rising as computing and other indoor services expand, and much of this energy ultimately remains inside buildings as heat. We develop an economic framework for evaluating electricity use when its incidental heat can be repurposed for thermal comfort. The framework defines the dynamic effective cost of electricity (DECE) as the retail price net of the discounted value of incidental heat that can be used over time. The model yields closed-form expressions for the shadow value of stored heat and characterizes conditions under which insulation and incidental heat act as dynamic complements or substitutes. In well-insulated buildings in cold climates, the ECE of certain appliances can approach zero; in milder or cooling-dominated regimes, continuous high loads can raise ECE above the tariff. The framework provides a tractable basis for valuing insulation, electricity efficiency, and time-of-use tariffs.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着计算和其他室内服务的扩展，电力使用量正在上升，而这些能量中的大部分最终以热量的形式留在建筑物内。我们开发了一个经济框架，用于评估当附带热量可以重新用于热舒适时的电力使用。该框架将动态有效电力成本（DECE）定义为零售价格减去可随时间使用的附带热量的折现价值。模型得出了储存热量影子价值的闭式表达式，并刻画了保温与附带热量作为动态互补品或替代品的条件。在寒冷气候下保温良好的建筑中，某些电器的ECE可以接近零；在较温和或以制冷为主的地区，持续高负荷可能使ECE高于电价。该框架为评估保温、电力效率和分时电价提供了易于处理的基础。

articles.title_en: Profit-enhancing emissions taxes in near-zero-emissions industries
articles.title_cn: 近零排放行业中的利润增强型排放税
articles.abstract_en: Motivated by the recent global trend toward realizing net-zero-emissions societies, we investigate the relationship between emissions tax rates and firm profits in oligopolistic markets. Our results indicate that when equilibrium emission levels are close to zero, a marginal increase in the tax rate raises firms’ profits, except in monopoly markets. This effect arises because stringent environmental regulation increases marginal costs and softens competition, allowing firms to expand their markups. We further show that this result is robust to cost heterogeneity. Our findings also highlight the importance of considering environmental and competition policies jointly.
articles.abstract_cn: 受近期全球迈向净零排放社会趋势的启发，我们研究了寡头垄断市场中排放税率与企业利润之间的关系。我们的结果表明，当均衡排放水平接近零时，税率的边际提高会增加企业利润，但垄断市场除外。这一效应产生的原因是，严格的环境监管提高了边际成本并缓和了竞争，使企业能够扩大其加成率。我们进一步证明，这一结果在成本异质性下依然稳健。我们的发现还强调了将环境政策与竞争政策联合考虑的重要性。

articles.title_en: On high-quality development and two-tier stochastic frontier analysis
articles.title_cn: 论高质量发展与双边随机前沿分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper replicates, reevaluates, and extends the two-tier stochastic frontier analysis (2TSF) of the High-Quality Development (HQD) indicator in China proposed by Lei et al. (2024). We first conduct a successful replication of the study’s main estimation results. We then investigate methodological issues involving the construction of the HQD variable, inconsistencies in the data, and the application of the two-tier stochastic frontier framework.
